svg.title: Figure 4. Evidence tiers: what each adds, what it cannot establish, who may see it
svg.desc: Table of evidence tiers for a university learning assistant: operational records, ratings, comments, and selected chats and attachments, plus synthetic scenarios and academic-impact evidence set apart. Columns: what each tier answers, what it cannot establish, protection and recipients, and the student's choice. A student need not progress through all tiers; each tier is useful on its own.
